channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: BYD marks Sealion 6’s second year with exclusive drive-in cinema
item.description: BYD Cars Philippines celebrated the Sealion 6 DM-i’s second year in the local market by hosting an exclusive drive-in cinema… The post BYD marks Sealion 6’s second year with exclusive drive-in cinema appeared first on Autocar Philippines .

item.title: Mitsubishi Motors Opens Silang, Cavite Dealership
item.description: Mitsubishi Motors Philippines Corporation (MMPC), in partnership with Mizukawa Motors Corporation (MZM), officially opened Mitsubishi Motors Silang, a new 3S dealership that further strengthens the brand's presence in one of the country's fastest-growing economic corridors. Read More »

item.title: Tesla, EastWest set August EV event
item.description: East West Banking Corporation and Tesla Philippines will hold another private event for selected bank clients on 10 August.

item.title: Hyundai starts Tuguegarao service operations
item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) has inaugurated Hyundai Tuguegarao, its first service and parts dealership in the city, to extend aftersales support to customers across Cagayan and nearby areas.

item.title: RADAR expands Cebu network
item.description: RADAR EV Pickup Philippines has opened its Cebu dealership with Pacific Autoworld Inc., giving the brand a stronger base for serving customers across the Visayas.

item.title: Nissan returns to profit under recovery plan
item.description: Nissan Motor Co. returned to profit in the first quarter of fiscal 2026 after more than a year of restructuring under its Re:Nissan recovery plan.

item.title: Suzuki begins work on Iguig dealership
item.description: Suzuki Philippines has started construction of Suzuki Auto Iguig, a new dealership that will serve customers in Cagayan and nearby areas.

item.title: Jetour T2 surpasses 500K global sales
item.description: Jetour has sold more than 500,000 units of the T2 worldwide, less than three years after the midsize SUV made its global debut in 2023.

item.title: FINN AGAIN
item.description: Paris, France (AFP) — Finn Sami Pajari won his home rally on Sunday, protecting an overnight lead through the final day’s two specials to finish ahead of fellow Toyota drivers Oliver Solberg and Elfyn Evans.

item.title: Alex Palou Wins at Portland for Sixth IndyCar Victory in 2026
item.description: Palou moves one step closer to a fourth championship in five years with his win in the Pacific Northwest.

item.title: LA Metro To Give $600 To 2,000 LA County Residents Who Don't Drive Their Car For Five Weeks
item.description: With the 2028 Olympics on the horizon, Los Angeles Metro is offering a cash incentive to convince residents that they can get around without a car.

item.title: The Rarest Lexus V10 In America Just Sat There And Quadrupled In Value
item.description: One of only 25 US-destined Lexus LFA Nürburgring Package cars has barely been driven and now seeks its next owner
